release.notes: DEV TEST ONLY — Build 15.10.13 MIDI/SoundFont Profiling (vc74). Silent load diagnostics: records stage timings (MIDI file preparation, SoundFont init/reuse, MIDI stream creation, lyric timeline, melody analysis, ready/play command), total duration and Java/native allocated heap snapshots. Controls > Performance Diagnostics displays the last 24 song loads, copy/clear locally. No song titles or paths collected, no telemetry. DEV build suppresses automatic OTA banners, update notifications and scheduled update checks; manual check under Software Updates > Developer works as usual. Phase 1 library optimization is retained. MIDI synthesis, lyric/tempo event mapping, scoring, melody control, queue and remote protocol unchanged. Performance improvement not yet claimed; device testing required. Beta/Stable untouched.
